safe.en: River levels normal. Graze as usual. Dial *384*96428# if water rises.
safe.sw: Kiwango cha maji ni kawaida. Endelea kulisha mifugo. Piga *384*96428# maji yakiinuka.
safe.trk: [Turkana] Water normal. Graze usual. Call *384*96428# if rise.
safe.orm: [Oromo] Bishaan normal. Feed animals. *384*96428# yoo ol ka'e.
safe.am: [Amharic] የውሃ መጠን መደበኛ። *384*96428# ውሃ ከፍ ካለ።

watch.en: Rising water. Keep herds within 2 hours of high ground. Monitor ALMA.
watch.sw: Maji yanaongezeka. Weka mifugo karibu na mahali pa juu (saa 2).
watch.trk: [Turkana] Water rising. Stay near high ground.
watch.orm: [Oromo] Bishaan ol ka'aa. Ida'uu olaanaa dhiyeenyaatti turi.
watch.am: [Amharic] ውሃ እየጨመረ ነው። ከከፍተኛ ቦታ አቅራቢያ ይቆዩ።

warning.en: Flood likely 12–24h. Move herds to High-Ground Corridor. Safe forage ~8 days.
warning.sw: Mafuriko yanatarajiwa masaa 12–24. Hamisha mifugo korido ya juu. Malisho siku ~8.
warning.trk: [Turkana] Flood soon. Move herds high corridor.
warning.orm: [Oromo] Lolaa dhiyootti. Horii gara olaanaatti geessi.
warning.am: [Amharic] ጎርፍ በቅርብ። እንስሳትን ወደ ከፍተኛ መንገድ ያንቀሳቅሱ።

severe.en: COMPOUND FLOOD — move herds NOW 8km EAST to Corridor B. Water + forage 8 days.
severe.sw: MAFURIKO MAKALI — hamisha mifugo SASA km 8 MASHARIKI Korido B.
severe.trk: [Turkana] SEVERE — move herds EAST Corridor B now.
severe.orm: [Oromo] CIMA — horii amma gara Baha Corridor B.
severe.am: [Amharic] ከባድ ጎርፍ — እንስሳትን አሁን ወደ ምስራቅ Corridor B።

safe.en: Fields safe. Continue normal harvest plans.
safe.sw: Mashamba salama. Endelea na mavuno ya kawaida.

watch.en: Watch drainage near river plots. Bag seed & tools.
watch.sw: Angalia mifereji karibu na mto. Weka mbegu na zana.

warning.en: Harvest mature crops within 36h. Clear drains near Omorate/Kalam.
warning.sw: Vuna mazao yaliyoiva ndani ya masaa 36. Safisha mifereji.
warning.am: [Amharic] የበሰሉ ሰብሎችን በ36 ሰዓት ውስጥ ይሰብስቡ።

severe.en: Leave floodplain plots now. Move grain to high storage. Do not cross swollen channels.
severe.sw: Acha mashamba ya bonde sasa. Hamisha nafaka mahali pa juu.

safe.en: Lake edge normal. Fish as usual; keep radio on.
safe.sw: Ziwa ni kawaida. Vua kawaida; weka redio.

watch.en: Watch lake rise. Secure nets above 3m waterline.
watch.sw: Angalia ziwa. Linda nyavu juu ya mita 3.

warning.en: Upstream surge ~18h to delta. Anchor boats above 5m waterline.
warning.sw: Mawimbi ya juu ~masaa 18. Funga boti juu ya mita 5.
warning.am: [Amharic] ማዕበል ~18 ሰዓት። ጀልባዎችን ከ5ሜ በላይ ያስሩ።

severe.en: COMPOUND surge — pull boats now. No night fishing. High ground camps only.
severe.sw: Mawimbi makali — vuta boti sasa. Hakuna uvuvi usiku.

safe.en: No elevated waterborne risk. Maintain routine clinic stocks.
safe.sw: Hakuna hatari ya magonjwa ya maji. Dumisha dawa za kawaida.

watch.en: Prep ORS and chlorine at riverside posts.
watch.sw: Andaa ORS na klorini kwenye vituo vya mtoni.

warning.en: Waterborne disease risk rises 3–5 days post-flood. Stock purification kits.
warning.sw: Hatari ya magonjwa baada ya mafuriko siku 3–5. Weka vifaa vya kusafisha maji.

severe.en: Activate cholera readiness. Move mobile clinics above flood line.
severe.sw: Washa utayari wa kolera. Hamisha kliniki juu ya mafuriko.
